v: aDoBAga
aDaroBAgaH aDara + praTamArTe asi karmma॰ । aDaraBAge “pUrvvaBAgo guruH puMsAmaDoBAgastu yozitAmiti” ।
m: अधो-भाग m. the lower or lowest part, especially of the body.
अधो-भाग-दोष-हर mfn. curing or strengthening the lower part of the body.
land at the foot of a hill.

v: aDoBakta
na॰ aDaraM BaktaM yasmAt aDara + praTamArTe asi 5 ta॰ । BaktaBojanAnte pIyamAnajale ।
m: अधो-भक्त n. a dose of medicine to be taken after eating.

s: klI, (aDaH nIcadeSasTaM BuvanaM lokaH karmmaDArayaH .) pAtAlaM । ityamaraH ॥
v: aDoBuvana

na॰ aDaramaDaH Buvanam lokaH । saptasu pAtAlezu । tatsTAnaYca “BUmerardDaM kzArasinDorudaksTaM jambudvIpaM prAhurAcAryyavaryyAH ardDe'nyasmin dvIpazawkasya yAmye kzArakzIrAdyambuDInAM niveSaH ॥ lavaRajalaDirAdO dugDasinDuSca tasmAdamftamamftaraSmiH SrISva yasmAdbaBUva । mahitacaraRapadmaH padmajanmAdidevErvasati sakalavAso vAsudevaSca yatra ॥ daDno Gftasyekzurasasya tasmAnmadyasya ca svAdujalasya cAntyaH । svAdUdakAntarbaqavAnalo'sO pAtAlalokAH pfTivIpuwAnIti si॰ Si॰ ॥ aDikaM BUgolaSabde vakzyate ।

k.v: अधोभुनपातालं बलिसद्म रसातलम्.  नागलोकोऽथ कुहरं शुषिरं विवरं बिलम्.।

v: aDo'Das
aDas + aDastAt sAmIpye dvitvam । samIpADodeSe “navAnaDoDobfhataH payoDarAniti” mAGaH ।

s: strI, (aDaH aDodeSAdAraBya GaRweva PalaM yasyAH sA .) apAmArgaH । iti ratnamAlA ॥
v: aDoGaRwA
strI aDarAt aDastAdAraBya GaRweva tadAkAraPalavattvAt । apAmArge ratnamAlA ।
m: अधो-घण्टा f. the plant Achyranthes Aspera.

s: klI, (aDaH nIcadeSasTam aMSukaM vastraM, karmmaDArayaH .) pariDAnavastraM । ityamaraH ॥
v: aDo'MSuka
na॰ aDaramaMSukam aDara + praTamArTe asi aDarasya aDAdeSaSca । pariDAnavastre ।
m: अधो—ऽंशुक n. a lower garment, L.
अधो-ऽश्वम् ind. under the horse, KātyŚr.

v: aDoakza

tri॰ aDaH akzasya, aDastAt akzati aSnute vA akza--ac, aSa--sa vA vede atolopABAvaH । aDarastAd vyApake । “aDoakzAH sinDavaH srotyABiriti” f॰ 3 63, 9, “yadApaH akzasyADastAdBavanti tadA raTAdIni netuM Sakyante” iti BA॰ ।

m: अधो—बाण m. N. of a mountain, Divyāv.

v: aDodAru
na॰ aDaraM dAru aDara + praTamArTe asi । kAzWamayadvArasyADarakAzWe (govarAw) ।

m: अधो-देश m. the lower or lowest part (especially of the body).

v: aDodfzwi

tri॰ aDarasmin aDaH dfzwirasya । yogAByAsasamaye nAsikAgramAtradarSanayukte, tatprakArastu “kiYcit prakASastimitogratArErBrUvikriyAyAM virataprasaNgEH । netrEravispanditapakzmamAlErlakzyIkftaGrARamaDomayUKEriti” kumAre “karaRAnyabahizkftya sTARuvanniScalAtmakaH । AtmAnaM hfdaye DyAyennAsAgranyastalocana” iti yogasAre “gItAyAmapi “sampaSyan nAsikAgraM svamityAdinA” darSitaH । aDodarSanayuktamAtre tri॰ । “aDodfzwirnEkftika” iti manuH 4, 196 । karmma॰ । aDasTadfzwO strI ।
m: अधो-दृष्टि mfn. having a downcast look.

v: aDodiS
strI aDarA diS aDara + praTamArTe asi karmma॰ । dakziRasyAM diSi । asyA aDaratvaYcodakSabde vakzyate ।
m: अधो-दिश् f. the lower region, the nadir.
अधो-द्वार n. the anus, pudendum muliebre.

v: aDogAmin
tri॰ aDarasmin aDaH gacCati gama--Rini । narakagAmini, aDoBAge--gantari ca । striyAM NIp ।

k.v: उन्दुरुर्मूषकोऽप्याखुर्गिरिका बालमूषिका। सरटः कृकलासः स्यान्मुसली गृहगोधिका॥

v: aDogati

strI aDarasmin aDastAt narakAdO gatiH narakAdigamane “sADakAnAM tvaDogatiriti” tantra॰ । narakasya ca pApaPalatvena puRyAdaDaratvAt aDaratvam “Orve ca sarve narakAH sadEtyA” iti (si॰ Siro॰) OrvasTAne eva narakasTitiruktA OrvasTiti Sca । “svAdUdakAntarbaqavAnalo'sO pAtAlalokAH pfTivIpuwAnI” tyanena pAtAlasannikfzwe tatrEvoktA । ato narakAnAmaDaHsTatvam, BUgolaSabde vivaraRaM dfSyam । “jaGanyaguRavfttAstu aDogacCanti tAmasA ityukteH tAmasAnAmaDogatitvam । aDogatitvaYca pApAdeva । aDaHpradeSamAtre gamane ca “mUlAnAmaDogatiriti” kAda॰ । aDo'DastAt gatiryyasya ba॰ । narakagAmini tri॰ “anapekzitamaryyAdaM nAstikaM vipraluptakam arakzitAramattAraM nfpaM vidyAdaDogatimiti” manuH 8, 39, 41, aDogatiM narakagAminamiti kullUkaBawwaH ।
m: अधो-गति, f. or अधो—गम, m. or अधो—गमन, n. descent, downward movement, degradation.
अधो-गति and अधो—गामिन्, mfn. going downwards, descending.

v: aDojAnu
na॰ aDaraM jAnunaH praTamArTe asi । jAnuno'Dare brAhmaRAdInAM pramARaviSezamaBiDAya “sarvezAM vADojAnu iti kA॰ 21, 4, 18, “vA vikalpArTe sarvezAM jAnunoraDastAt aDojAnviti” tadvyAKyA ।
m: अधो-जानु ind. below the knee, ŚBr.

s: strI, (alpA jihvA kan striyAM wAp, aDaH aDarA jihvikA karmmaDArayaH .) tAlumUlasTakzudrajihvA । iti hArAvalI ॥ Aljiva iti BAzA ।
v: aDojihvikA
strI alpA jihvA jihvikA alpArTe kan aDo'DarA jihvikA karmma॰ । (AlajiBa) iti KyAtAyAm tAlusTajihvikAyAm ।
aDo'kza
na॰ aDaramakzaM yatra mArge aDara + praTamArTe asi ba॰ । havirDAnAkzADomArge । “dakziRasyAkzaM prAYco nizkrAmatIti” kA॰ 12, 4, 14, dakziRahavirDAnAkzADomArgeRa prANmuKA niHsarantIti” vedadIpaH ।
m: अधो-ऽक्ष mfn. being below (or not coming up to) the axle, RV. iii, 33, 9.
a: अधोऽक्ष, अधोंशुक, अधोऽक्षज — See under अधस्.

s: puM, (aDaH jYAtftvABAvAt hInam akzajaM pratyakzajYAnaM yasya saH । akzAt indriyAt jAyate akza + jan qa, paYcamItat .) vizRuH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA mahABArate । aDo na kzIyate jAtu yasmAttasmAdaDokzajaH .)
v: aDo'kzaja

pu॰ akzAt indriyAt jAyate jana--qa 5 ta॰ । akzajaM pratyakzajYAnam aDaraM grAhakatvABAvAdDInaM yasya aDara--praTamArTe asi aDAdeSaSca । indriyAyogye, “aDo na kzIMyate jAtu yasmAttasmAdaDo'kzaja” ityuktalakzaRe, vA vizRO । “vyAptI vAyuraDo'kzaja” iti vizRusaha॰ । “dyOrakzaM pfTivI cADastayoryasmAdajAyata । maDye vErAjarUpeRa tato'Dokzajaizyate” iti BAzye taTA ca aRqakapAladvayamaDye virAqrUpeRa jAtatvAdasya taTAtvam । aDoBUte svasvavizayeByo nivarttanena pratyakpravAMhite akzagaRe jAyate prakASate iti aDokzaja iti vA । tatrEvArTe ।
m: अधो-ऽक्ष-ज m. N. of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa

k.v: देवकीनन्दनः शौरिः श्रीपतिः पुरुषोत्तमः। वनमाली बलिध्वंसी कंसारातिरधोक्षजः॥

m: अधो-ऽक्षम् [KātyŚr.] or अधो-ऽक्षेण [ĀśvŚr.], ind. under the axle.

v: aDoloka
pu॰ aDo'Daro lokaH karmma॰ । BUmeraDaHsTapAtAle । aDoBuvanaSabde vivaraRam ।

k.v: अन्तरीयोपसंव्यानपरिधानान्यधोंशुके। द्वौ प्रावारोत्तरासङ्गौ समौ बृहतिका तथा॥

s: [n] klI, (aDaH aDaraM marma CidraM .) guhyadvAraM । iti hemacandraH ॥
strI, (aDomuKaM yasyAH sA, striyAM wAp .) gojihvAvfkzaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
m: अधो-मुखा f. the plant Premna Esculenta.

s: tri, (aDomuKaM yasya saH .) aDovadanaH । pAtAlamuKaH । tatparyyAyaH । avANmuKaH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ avAcInaH 3 । iti jawADaraH ॥ aDomuKanakzatragaRo yaTA, -- “aSlezavahniyamapitryaviSAKayuktaM pUrvvatrayaM SataBizA ca navApyuqUni । etAnyaDomuKagaRAni SuBAni nityaM vidyArGyaBUmiKananezu ca SoBitAni” ॥ iti jyotiHsArasaMgrahaH ।
v: aDomuKa

tri॰ aDo muKaM yasya ba॰ । jyotizaSAstre prasidDezu nakzatraBedezu । yaTA “mUlASlezA kfttikA ca viSAKA BaraRI taTA । maGA pUrvvAtrayaM cEva aDomuKagaRaH smfta” iti । gojihvAKyavfkze (anantamUla) avANmuKe striyAM vA NIz । “stabDadfzwiraDomuKa” iti “aDomuKErUrdDamuKESca patriBiH” iti raGuH । mudrABede ca tatsvarUpaM mudrASabde vakzyate ।
m: अधो-मुख mf(आ [Śiś.] or ई)n. having the face downwards
अधो-नाभम् or अधो-नाभि [MaitrS.], ind. below the navel.
अधो—नापित m. the son of a Karaṇa and an Ambaṣṭhā (who catches fish), L.
अधो—नीवी f. having the girdle slipped down, MBh.
अधो-निलय m. ‘lower abode’, the lower regions, hell.
अधो—निवीत mfn. having the sacred thread hanging down, ĀśvGṛ. (cf. IW. 196)

v: aDopahAsa
pu॰ aDaH aDoBAgasya smaramandirasya upahAsaH sanDiSCAndasaH । strIRAmaDoBAgasyopahasane । “yaevaM vidvAnaDopahAsaM caratyAsAM, strIRAM sukftaM vfNkta” iti vf॰ upa॰ । vfNkte AvarjjayatIti BAzyam ।
m: अधोपहास (धस्-उप्), m. sexual intercourse, ŚBr. xiv.
a: अधोपहासः — [अधः अधोभागस्य योन्याः उपहासः छांदसः संधिः, स्त्रीणामधोभागस्य उपहसनं Tv.] Ved. Sexual intercourse.

v: aDorAma
pu॰ aDoBAge aDastAdBAge rAmaH SuklaH dfzwitarpakatvAt tasya rAmatvam । aDoBAge SuklavarRe “ASvinAvaDorAmAviti” ya॰ 24, 1, “aDorAmO aDoBAge SuklavarRAvajAviti” vedadIpaH ।
m: अधो-राम m. (a goat) having peculiar white or black marks on the lower part (of the body), VS.; ŚBr.
अधो-रक्त-पित्त n. discharge of blood from the anus and the urethra.

s: puM, (aDaH aDaraH vAyaH karmmaDArayaH .) apAnavAyuH । yaTA, -- “kzute'DovAyugamane jfmBaRe japamutsajet” । iti tantrasAre yoginIhfdayaM ॥
v: aDovAyu
pu॰ aDogAmI vAyuH SA॰ ta॰ । apAnavAyO parddaSabdakArake vAte “aDovAyusamutsarge prahAse'nftaBAzaRe” ityupakramya “karmma kurvannupaspfSe” dityuktaM smftO ।
m: अधो-वायु m. vital air passing downwards

v: aDovarcas
tri॰ aDogAmi varcaH jyotiryasya । avAcInajyotizke “tatte vidvAn varuRa! prabravImyaDovarcasa” iti vedaH ।
m: अधो-वर्चस् mfn. tumbling downwards, AV. v, 11, 6.
अधो-यन्त्र n. the lower part of an apparatus
